en.text: Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

zhSimplified.text: 倚靠耶和华的人 好像锡安山，永不动摇。

zhTraditional.text: 倚靠耶和華的人 好像錫安山，永不動搖。

en.text: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

zhSimplified.text: 众山怎样围绕耶路撒冷， 耶和华也照样围绕他的百姓， 从今时直到永远。

zhTraditional.text: 眾山怎樣圍繞耶路撒冷， 耶和華也照樣圍繞他的百姓， 從今時直到永遠。

en.text: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人的杖不常落在义人的分上， 免得义人伸手作恶。

zhTraditional.text: 惡人的杖不常落在義人的分上， 免得義人伸手作惡。

en.text: Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你善待那些为善 和心里正直的人。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你善待那些為善 和心裏正直的人。

en.text: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 至于那偏行弯曲道路的人， 耶和华必使他和作恶的人一同出去受刑。 愿平安归于以色列！

zhTraditional.text: 至於那偏行彎曲道路的人， 耶和華必使他和作惡的人一同出去受刑。 願平安歸於以色列！
